Ana (CSM): Quick sync — Helix Labs dedicated pool go‑live planned Tue 2026-03-31. Need final quota numbers, autoscale guardrails, and load test window. Renewal team flagged risk if we can't hold 95th <250ms under peak. :warning:
Priya (SRE): Copy. Current proposal: baseline 2 instances, reserved quota 120rps, burst headroom to 320rps for 10m windows. Autoscale policy 'helix-ramp-v1' with cooldown 60s, scale step +2. Thoughts? :thinking:
Jen (Eng): I like the policy. Add a canary route and model-fallback to gpt-small when latency >300ms. Canary at 5% for first 30m of traffic shift. I'll push config to the rollout playbook.
Mike (Product): From Helix product side — their traffic mix is 65% chat, 35% embeddings during peak. They'll start heavy generation at 09:00 PT on day 1. QA to run load test Thurs 09:00 PT to validate.
QA (Tester): Ack. I'll run the synthetic mix script and post results. Ramp plan: 0 -> 50 -> 150 -> 320 rps over 45m. Script snippet: ```bash
./ramp_load --target 320 --steps 4 --pattern chat:0.65,embed:0.35 --seed 2026
```
Ana (CSM): Also note Helix asked for token-level cost estimate for burst windows. Can infra capture per-token breakdown in the smoke run? @Priya
Priya (SRE): Yes — enable token-metering header and trace id. We'll export to S3 path s3://rl-infer/helix/loadtests/2026-03. I'll add a dashboard tile for 95th latency and unit cost.
capacity-bot: Reserved pool HLX-2026 allocated: pool_id=HLX-42, gpu_quota=4, max_instances=8. See: https://console.redwood/pools/HLX-42
Jen (Eng): One caveat — Helix wants long-context config (32k). That changes throughput dramatically. For 32k we should plan 4x the baseline GPU memory or set a model-quant profile. Recommend reducing burst target to 200rps if they're on 32k until we validate.
Mike (Product): I'll confirm which context they will use in the early days. If they start with 16k we can keep original numbers. Ana, please get a confirmation by EOD.
Ana (CSM): On it. I'll ping the Helix technical contact and ask for context length + expected concurrency. Also scheduling a pre-go call Mon 16:00 PT. Invite: @Priya @Jen @Mike.
Priya (SRE): For the load test I'll add an automated chaos step at 20m (simulate one GPU node OOM) to validate fallback path and autoscale reaction. Documented in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helix-onboard.md
QA (Tester): After load run I'll post a short summary with 95/99 latencies, error rates, and per-token cost. Will also attach raw artifacts.
Ana (CSM): Perfect — action items: Ana = confirm context (EOD), Priya = prepare autoscale + metering (Mon AM), Jen = push canary+fallback config (Mon AM), QA = run load test Thu 09:00 PT and post results. I'll escalate renewal concern if we can't meet 250ms. :thumbsup:
Priya (SRE): Got it. I'll also add an emergency fallback route to the hosted model if Dedicated latency breaches 400ms.
Jen (Eng): Will do. I'll leave a short note in the rollout PR about rollback criteria.
Mike (Product): Thanks all. Ping me if any blockers.
Ana (CSM): Thanks team — closing thread until Mon pre-go. :rocket:
